meta.note: Transportstyrelsen says flying closer than 5 km to any runway needs air traffic control permission at any height, and that heliports need coordination within 1,000 m. This circle is 5 km from the airport's centre, not its runway, and is drawn at every airport in the open data, so it is only a guide. Heliports are not shown. Use LFV's drone chart for the real zones.
